messages.subject: Run error with task 16 failed - "NA/NaN argument"
parts:
Hello, everyone!

I’m running RSWAT (SWAT+) with daily inputs from 2008–2024, using 2008 as the warm-up year. When I click Run SWAT, I get the error shown in the screenshot: task 16 failed - 'NA/NaN argument'.”

What typically causes this? Could it be related to the size of the daily dataset, or is it more likely a configuration issue?
